about: Flyte Aviation, Inc. provides on-demand private aviation charter services. The company operates two service lines, Hops and Luxe, for private air travel. Through Hops, the company offers short-haul private charter services using company-managed aircraft on regional routes across the New York Metro Area, Long Island, New England, and the Eastern seaboard. The company also enables customers to bid on available empty-leg flights in real time through Hops. Through Luxe, the company offers a brokerage service that matches passengers seeking larger or longer-range aircraft with vetted third-party aircraft operators and crews for on-demand charters and bespoke travel coordination. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer mobile application and website that handles flight booking, scheduling, pricing, payment, and dispatch. It serves private aviation travelers across the Northeast, Southeast, and select other regional markets in the United States. It also manufactures health care equipment. Flyte Aviation, Inc. was formerly known as Catheter Precision, Inc. and changed its name to Flyte Aviation, Inc. in October 2026. Flyte Aviation, Inc. was founded in 2002 and is based in Fort Mill, South Carolina.
